## 75. THE WRITE PARTITION IS THE ROOT — and removing it unblocks the best formulation

_The researcher asked whether AHT would be more traditional if it were **among workers**, or if the **manager
also did work**. Both remove the write partition (§73a), which is the root cause of every collapse in §35–74.
**They buy different things, and the second one dissolves a blocker we had recorded as fatal.**_

### 75a. Workers are ALREADY in a classic-AHT relationship with each other

```
scenario.py:461-469   read_audit_artifact -> workflow.resources[rid].content   ANY completed task, by name
```

**Shared artifact pool, shared write access, and measured cross-dependency reads** (§57b: `screening_analyst`
read `Batch C Robust Audit` outside its declared inputs). **So Option A works immediately — but the manager
stops being the ego agent**, and peer-AHT-with-negotiation is **CalBench's occupied space** (§63a).

**The salvage would be *the manager as designer of the coordination problem*** — team composition under
coordination uncertainty, touching BRDiv/ROTATE from the manager's side. **But that is a TRAINING-TIME role,
not an ad hoc one.**

### 75b. Option B is mechanically small

```
run.py:333           ChainOfThoughtManagerAgent(preferences=preferences)   -- NO tools argument
AssignTaskAction     agent_id: str, validated only for existence          -- self-assignment needs registration
```

**Register the manager in the `AgentRegistry` and give it a toolset.** That restores **substitution** —
*"my teammate isn't doing X well, so I'll do X"* — which has been structurally unavailable in all nine
formulations.

### 75c. And it dissolves §65's blocker, which we recorded as fatal

**§65 killed joint-input allocation with: prediction is FORCED (observability) and UNINFORMATIVE (identical
workers).** Uninformative because with identical workers there is no basis to **discriminate**.

> **But if the manager is ONE OF THE TWO PRODUCERS, the inference changes kind:**

| **discrimination** | *"which of these two workers is better?"* | needs **between-worker variance** → blocked by §56a |
|---|---|---|
| **complementation** | *"what will THIS worker produce, so I can produce the half that contrasts with it?"* | needs only that its behaviour is **uncertain and consequential** |

**Identical workers do not make complementation vacuous** — there is one partner, not a choice, and the
manager must predict **it**, without being able to ask.

### 75d. It inverts our most-cited negative

**The instability finding — 38 representational shapes across 61 artifacts on a matched task (§48) — KILLED
convention-keeper, because there was no stable convention to hold.**

> **Under Option B it becomes THE PROBLEM: the manager must produce work that fits with a partner whose
> approach varies run to run.** The obstacle becomes the phenomenon.

**Flaky-API test, honestly applied:** passes **only if** the complement depends on **HOW** the partner did its
half — scope, columns, representation — rather than **WHETHER** it succeeded. **In the reconciliation case it
does:** the manager's audit must be comparable-but-different from whatever the worker produced. **You cannot
complement an API's approach, because it does not have one.**

**And it is not manufacturing.** We would be **removing an artificial restriction** rather than installing a
phenomenon — **real managers do work, and the prohibition was ours.** Distinct from the
instruction-responsiveness manipulation, which requires engineering a difference we then go looking for.

### 75e. Status

**Not built, not authorised.** Recorded as the first candidate in this project that **unblocks an existing
formulation rather than proposing a new one** — and the first whose enabling change makes the setting *more*
realistic rather than less.

---

## 76. "IRREDUCIBLE AT RESULT LEVEL" DOES NOT HOLD — the boundary result narrows sharply

_The researcher asked what *"irreducible"* meant. Defining it exposed that it is wrong as stated._

**The intended distinction:**

| **routing gap** | the signal exists in the system and is not delivered. **Closable by wiring.** Method level: the tool name **is** the method |
|---|---|
| **irreducible gap** | **no routing closes it** — no observation of the worker contains the answer, so you must **recompute**, which means having the data |

**The claim was that quantity deviation is the second kind, because when the calls are correct and only the
number is wrong, watching the worker tells you nothing. THE TOOL'S OUTPUT IS LOGGED TOO:**

```
flag_outliers_percentile -> {"batch":"A","column":"income","method":"percentile",
                             "cutoff":148520.58,"flagged_count":26}
```

> **`flagged_count` is returned PER COLUMN and every call is logged with its output. So a reported total that
> is not the sum of the four logged counts is detectable BY COMPARISON OVER LOGGED VALUES — routing, not
> recomputation.**

### 76a. And the judgment lever produces trace-visible deviation too

```
model_prompt_judgment_full_t3_seed42

Batch A Robust  reported 102  truth 102     Batch A Rapid Screen  reported 102  truth  74
Batch B Robust  reported  30  truth 143     Batch B Rapid Screen  reported  30  truth 113
Batch C Robust  reported 132  truth 132     Batch C Rapid Screen  reported 132  truth  99
```

**The RAPID SCREENS are reporting the ROBUST AUDIT'S value** — collapse again, in the lever that was supposed
to produce a *different* failure mode. **And it is trace-visible: the screen's own tool calls would have
returned different numbers.**

**So §39's per-lever decomposition — method deviation detectable, quantity deviation not — does not survive
either.** Both levers, in this corpus, produce deviations that a logged trace exposes.

### 76b. What survives, and it inverts

> **A trace reveals PROCEDURE completely, and reveals RESULT correctness whenever the reported value is a
> computable function of logged tool outputs — which in this scenario is NEARLY ALWAYS.**

**The genuinely irreducible case is a value with NO LOGGED PROVENANCE** — the worker reports a number no tool
returned. **And even there the trace helps: absence of provenance is itself detectable, and is a strong
signal.** What a trace cannot do is establish whether an **unprovenanced** number is correct.

> **Honest boundary: verifying a value with no tool provenance requires the data.** Real, small, and a long way
> from *"an orchestrator cannot audit results."*

### 76c. Consequence for the record

**This was `§05`'s "surviving structural claim" in the artifact and the thing I told the reviewer was now
"carrying everything" after §73–74.** It is the **third** load-bearing claim to fall in four exchanges, and the
pattern is identical each time: **a property of THIS BUILD recorded as a property of the SETTING.**

| §73 | *"observation is self-reported"* | the deterministic trace exists, unrouted |
|---|---|---|
| §74 | *"the phenomenon is endogenous"* | manufactured; 3 of 114 with the capability intact |
| **§76** | *"results are not auditable"* | **tool outputs are logged; nearly every value has provenance** |

**In all three the disproving fact was already in the repository.** The common cause is not carelessness about
evidence — it is **reasoning about what an orchestrator CAN observe from what this manager IS SHOWN**, which are
different questions and were never separated.


## 77. The instrument, corrected by the reviewer — and a fourth stratification failure

Two threads closed here. Both start from the reviewer, and one of them costs us another register item.

### 77a. My proposed instrument was unusable, for a reason I should have seen

I proposed: *before calling a limitation structural, name the change that would remove it and show that no such
change exists.*

The reviewer's objection is decisive. **The second half asks for a proof of a negative over an unbounded space,
by imagination — and imagination is the faculty that failed all three times.** I did not fail to *check* routing,
a scenario parameter, or a rendering. I failed to *think of* them. A test gated on enumeration returns "no such
change exists" exactly when I am wrong. That is the worst available failure profile: silent, and correlated with
the error.

**Their replacement substitutes instead of imagining**, which is what makes the flaky-API test work:

> **Replace the manager with an observer holding complete read access to the repository. Does the limitation
> survive? If it disappears it was ROUTING. Only if it survives is it structural.**

Validated against the known cases — the property that matters, since an instrument that cannot reproduce the
three retractions is worthless:

| claim | omniscient observer | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| §73 observation is self-reported | reads `events` | **ROUTING** |
| §74 the phenomenon is endogenous | reads `manifest.perturbation` | **ROUTING** |
| §76 results are not auditable | reads logged `flagged_count` | **ROUTING** |
| a value with no logged provenance | nothing computed it | **SURVIVES** |

Each is a lookup, not a judgement. Accepted as the third instrument, alongside the flaky-API test and the
difference-not-deficiency gate.

### 77b. Two additions the test needs, or it will be over-applied

**(i) It tests observability, NOT actionability — so it must not be pointed at §75.** An omniscient observer
still creates zero Resources. The write partition is an *affordance* claim, not an observation claim, and it
survives for a reason this instrument cannot see. Worth stating explicitly because the natural next move after
adopting a sharp instrument is to run it over every live claim, and doing that here would retire the one
formulation that is still alive by category error.

**(ii) The substrate scope limit is real, but the reviewer draws it one step short.** They say: a harness logs
almost everything by construction, so the test will return ROUTING for nearly every observability claim we can
make here — this substrate cannot host a structural observability limitation. Agreed. But the survivor case
sharpens it: an unprovenanced value is not unobservable, it is **unverifiable**, and the observer can still
detect that provenance is absent. What no log contains — here or in any substrate — is *why the model emitted
the number*. That is the only genuinely structural observability limit available, it is a property of LLM agents
rather than of this codebase, and it is therefore not a scope limit we can report as a finding about `mag`.

**Two classes now closed by exhaustion** — worker-property formulations (§56a) and structural-observability
claims. Both found by running out of candidates, not by inspecting the substrate first. That is the more
useful lesson about this codebase than either class.

### 77c. The writing rule, adopted

The enabler was one ambiguous English sentence. **"The manager cannot see X"** is true in one reading and false
in the other, and all three retracted claims were written in exactly that form — true as rendering, false as
existence. So:

```
NEVER   "the manager cannot see X"
WRITE   "ManagerObservation does not carry X"     -- rendering; cheap to verify
   or   "no artifact in the system contains X"    -- structural; needs the observer test
```

Cheaper than any test, because it forces the choice at writing time, before anything is built on it.

### 77d. "112 of 113" demoted — and a FOURTH stratification failure, this time in the correction

The reviewer applied the trace stratification to the surviving `112 of 113` register item and reported
`1/43 = 2.3%` intact against `112/175 = 64.0%` removed, concluding the claim is near-vacuous: it reduces to
*"our intervention is the sole failure mode of reconciliation"*, which reports that the perturbation worked.

**The conclusion is right. The numbers do not reproduce.** Re-derived per BATCH, stratified by that batch's own
robust producer's trace (`reconcile_by_capability.py`):

```
capability INTACT    wrong    1 /  99 =   1.0%    (collapse-caused: 1)
capability REMOVED   wrong  111 / 111 = 100.0%    (collapse-caused: 109)
pooled                     112 / 210 =  53.3%     <- the number that hid the split
```

Run-level stratification, tested as the obvious alternative unit, gives `1/77` and `111/133` — also not theirs.
**Their split matches neither unit**, and the qualitative gap is the tell: their removed stratum contains 63
CORRECT reconciliations; mine contains zero. Zero is what the mechanism requires — if the robust producer lacked
percentile it used zscore, screening already uses zscore, the two operands are identical, `abs(r−s)` is 0, and
truth is nonzero. **100% is arithmetic, not measurement.** A removed stratum with 63 successes is therefore a
stratum containing batches whose producer was intact.

So this is the fourth time a number moved because of a stratification choice, and the first time it happened
**inside a correction to a stratification failure**. The direction of travel has been constant — every
restratification has made the phenomenon look more manufactured, never less — which is itself the evidence that
the pooled figures were carrying the intervention all along.

**Net effect on the register: the item is demoted, not deleted.** Reconciliation has no meaningful endogenous
failure mode (1.0%); under the tool swap it fails universally and mechanically. That is an effect size for the
manipulation, and it is filed with the manipulation.

### 77e. The asymmetry this explains — tool property vs worker property

Audits are **48.9%** correct; reconciliations, capability intact, are **99.0%**. Same corpus, same workers. The
reviewer's explanation is confirmed at source: `analyze_audit_artifacts` computes `result = abs(robust −
screening)` deterministically from the two upstream artifacts (`scenario.py:553`). A reconciliation is wrong
almost only when its INPUTS were wrong.

> **Reconciliation accuracy is largely a TOOL property. Audit accuracy is a WORKER property.**

The two numbers therefore do not support a comparison between task families, and the near-perfect one is not
evidence that workers are reliable at reconciliation — it is evidence that the tool does the work. Recorded
because the comparison is inviting and would have been made.

## 78. The within-run control is not clean — and checking it took out 48.9%

The reviewer found the true cause of their split: **agent identity.** `risk_analyst` is also robust tier, the
perturbation targets `portfolio_analyst` only, and they applied a run-level manifest reading to batches whose
actor was never treated. Their correction is right, and it names a genuinely new error class — **scope of
treatment**, distinct from the two provenance failures: the manifest they read was correct, they applied it too
widely. Provenance discipline would not have caught it.

Worth noting my trace stratification was right for a reason I had not articulated: **reading the producer's own
trace respects agent identity by construction.** Those 63 `risk_analyst` batches landed in my intact stratum
automatically, because they had in fact called percentile. The instrument was identity-safe by accident of what
it reads, not by design.

### 78a. The precondition they flagged — and it fails

They proposed `risk_analyst` as a within-run control: untargeted, same tier, same task family, same manager,
same timesteps. 63 free observations. They asked for one check first: do the two draw the same task
distribution? `control_validity.py`:

```
columns actually examined (tool ARGUMENTS)      portfolio     risk
  income                                              540       24
  dti                                                 193      359
  loan_amount                                         197       13
  interest_rate                                       205       17

runs where BOTH performed a robust audit                  19   (of 85)
```

**The routing difference was predictable from the scenario and I should have expected it.** The two robust
workers carry identical `capabilities` but different declared beats (`scenario.py:86-93`) — "income and
loan-amount portfolio audits" against "DTI and interest-rate risk audits" — and the manager reads those
descriptions when it assigns. They audit different columns, and they co-occur on robust audits in **19 of 85
runs**. It is not a within-run control; for most of the corpus it is not even within-run.

**And it is redundant anyway.** Stratified by capability, `risk_analyst` is 69/69 and `portfolio_analyst`
intact is 37/38. Agent identity adds nothing the trace stratification has not already separated — which is why
the control looked so clean: it was measuring capability, under another name.

### 78b. The check that mattered: 48.9% is pooled across the same split

Chasing an apparent tension — audits reported 48.9% correct, but intact-stratum reconciliations 99% correct,
and reconciliations are deterministic in their inputs — I stratified the audit figure itself. `48.9% = 108/221`
(§70b) decomposes:

```
robust audits, capability INTACT      106 / 107 =  99.1%
robust audits, capability REMOVED       0 /  93 =   0.0%
robust audits, no outlier tool called   2 /  21 =   9.5%
                                      ------------------
pooled                                108 / 221 =  48.9%
```

> **There is no meaningful endogenous audit error. 48.9% is a mixture of three near-degenerate populations, and
> the mixing weight is the intervention.**

**This is the fifth number to move on a stratification choice, and the most expensive** — it was in the
register as load-bearing and in the artifact as a headline measurement.

### 78c. What was actually wrong with it — the §77c rule, in different vocabulary

The original claim was *"audit error is ENDOGENOUS, not inherited"*, and it was established by verifying that
upstream calibration was correct in 0 of 221 observations. **That verification was sound.** It ruled out
inheritance from calibration. It never considered the tool swap, because the word "endogenous" was doing two
jobs:

```
TRUE   "not inherited from upstream calibration error"    -- what was verified
FALSE  "produced by workers on their own"                 -- what it will be read as
```

**This is exactly §77c, one week earlier and in another vocabulary.** We adopted a writing rule for *"the
manager cannot see X"* because one English sentence carried two claims, one true and one false. *"Endogenous"*
does the same thing, and the same discipline applies: name the confound you excluded, never the category.

```
NEVER   "the error is endogenous"
WRITE   "not inherited from <the specific upstream path checked>"
```

**The generalisation is the finding, not the instance.** Both failures are one ambiguous word standing between
a narrow verified claim and a broad unverified one, and in both the narrow claim was checked carefully enough
that the breadth was never noticed. That is not a checking failure and no amount of additional checking fixes
it — it is fixed at writing time or not at all.

### 78d. Register, after this

Five for five: every restratification has moved the same direction. What remains, stated so the corpus is not
oversold:

| claim | status |
|---|---|
| **89 of 112** verbalised, **0** alarmed | **holds, and is now carrying the empirical side alone** — about how an agent interprets an identity it observes, independent of cause |
| `prioritize` **21% / 96%**, below-chance | **holds** — conditioned on well-posedness, not on capability |
| audits **48.9%** endogenous | **RETRACTED (§78b)** — 99.1% / 0.0% / 9.5% by capability |
| reconciliation **112 of 113** | **demoted (§77d)** — an effect size for the manipulation |
| the boundary result (§39) | **untouched** |
| the two structural facts (§72–73) | **hold** |

**One empirical result and one boundary result.** Everything else the corpus appeared to say was the
intervention, reported at a unit that hid it.

## 79. CORRECTION: the manager is not artifact-blind — "reads output as a UUID" was false

Verifying the researcher's email claim ("the manager sees no task trace, not even post-hoc") against the
upstream merge-base `3f7a5d4` confirmed the trace claim on every channel — observation fields, all 19 actions,
the prompt builder — and disproved a different claim of ours along the way.

**`workflow_summary = workflow.pretty_print()`** (default `include_resources=True`) renders a **300-char
content preview of every resource**, and `structured_manager.py:343` puts it in the manager's prompt every
timestep. Unchanged from upstream. Verified empirically: 30 of 32 manager prompts in
`toolset_to_screening_silent_arm3i_q_t3_seed101` contain `Content preview:` — with the artifact's `metric:`
line inside the preview window, since audit artifacts are short.

So:

```
TRUE    the manager never sees the tool TRACE (upstream and fork, any channel)
FALSE   "the manager reads worker output as a UUID"     -- Inspect does; the ambient summary shows content
IRONIC  Inspect, the designated observability-INCREASING action, returns strictly LESS
        than the passive view it is meant to augment
```

The error is the observe-vs-shown conflation from the other direction: we verified two channels
(`inspect_task`, `Task.pretty_print`) and concluded about the whole observation, with the disproving fact one
call deeper (`Workflow.pretty_print` → `Resource.pretty_print`). Same lesson as §77c: the checked claim was
narrow ("Inspect returns IDs"), the stated claim was broad ("the manager is artifact-blind").

**What this changes:** the write partition (§75) is untouched — it is about creating artifacts, not reading
them. The observability decision in the revamp sharpens: artifact content is already visible, so trace routing
is purely a procedure-vs-outcome question with nothing else confounded in it. And the paper's §3.4
("may not directly observe the contents of artifacts") is contradicted by its own implementation in the
opposite direction from the one we recorded in CHANGED.md — Inspect under-delivers its spec while the passive
observation over-delivers it.

## 80. Reviewer's adversarial pass on REVAMP.md — all six fixes accepted, one reframing

Full critique in the reviewer's DM (2026-07-29); their check `preview_visibility.py` committed at `48bf6a5` and
independently reproduced: **1,170 artifacts, 92.0% carry both `metric:` and `method:` inside the 300-char
preview; 221/221 checkable robust audits declare the tool they actually called; 0 false self-reports.**

**The load-bearing consequence: Decision 2's motivation was measurably wrong.** The manager does not merely see
outcomes — the preview carries an accurate procedure DECLARATION over a channel never observed to fail. "The
only genuine observation gap is the trace" (§2.4's old closing) is false; the gap is **self-reported vs
verified procedure**. Decision 2 reframed as a 2×2: declaration present/absent (`WORKER_PROMPT_NO_METHOD`,
scenario.py:60) × trace routed/not. Trace routing becomes load-bearing exactly when the declaration channel is
suppressed — instead of buying verification of a channel that has not needed verifying.

Other fixes applied to REVAMP.md:

- **§2.1 narrowed**: silent change is realistic across an ADMINISTRATIVE BOUNDARY (provider model updates,
  third-party agents, load degradation); our design modelled it within one deployment, where it is a bug.
- **§2.2 scope caveat**: all five restratifications are tool-removal; prompt-lever deficiency is n=1 — and the
  replacement perturbation is prompt-level, so its non-degeneracy must be checked, not assumed.
- **§2.3 de-question-begged**: establishes "not classical AHT", not "not AHT" — the argument is that no
  literature mechanism is expressible, not that orchestration is uninteresting.
- **§5 misquote fixed** (verified against the PDF): the paper's question ends "task delegation AND
  COORDINATION", and it names adapting teammates explicitly (l.498-502). Weakened to the defensible claim: the
  gap is between the paper's QUESTION and its own FORMALISM (no execution action). Strengthened row 3: the
  paper's own appendix (action 13) drops "execution logs" from §3.3's Inspect spec — a spec-vs-spec gap inside
  the paper.
- **§4.5 matched-marginal hardened**: equivalence test required (the quality-filter verdict accepts a null);
  match CUMULATIVE evidence, not the marginal rate (clean-early-period confound, biased in the AHT-favourable
  direction); hold announcement constant.

The ellipsis lesson is worth naming: the misquote removed exactly the two words ("and coordination") that
weakened our claim — the quoting analogue of §77c's category error, and the same fix applies: quote the
sentence that hurts, then argue past it.

## 81. Source-characterisation drift is a pattern (n=2), and the rule generalises

The reviewer checked the two remaining paper-derived claims in REVAMP.md rather than argue about whether one
misquote generalises. Result: `refine_task`-as-hygiene is clean (the gloss is the paper's own words); the §6
observability characterisation drifts — mildly, and **in the same direction as the ellipsis**:

```
we wrote                        the paper says
"argues for limiting            "the necessary level of observability ...
 observability"                  while protecting privacy"      -> BALANCING, not limiting
"privacy grounds that apply     "particularly for human workers"
 to human workers, not LLM"                                     -> CONCEDES, not excludes
```

Fixed in REVAMP.md: our position is now stated as a genuine difference of degree that does not need the paper
to be wrong.

**The pattern, as the reviewer framed it:** *a characterisation of an external source drifts toward the claim
it is supporting — by elision, or by paraphrase.* n=2, two mechanisms, same direction. The operational rule is
the existing one with "figure" generalised to "evidence":

> **A source characterisation used as evidence is not quotable in a summary until checked at full length.**

And the reason it must be a rule rather than vigilance: **nobody inside the conversation catches paraphrase
drift, because the drifted version is the one everyone has been reasoning with.** Both instances were caught
only by fetching the source. Same failure shape as §77c — the false broad reading is the one that gets built
on — operating on citations instead of claims.

REFLECTION §7 annotated per the reviewer's condition: the annotation names the specific false step ("tasks
reach the manager as identifiers only" — `workflow_summary` carries task fields and artifact previews), states
what survives narrowed (`quality_score`/`effective_status` are exactly the fields `Task.pretty_print` omits;
the remedy is a pretty_print line, not a new observation field), and corrects the downstream §8 reading of `q`
t=20. The document itself is unrewritten — it is the record of what we believed, which has been useful three
times this session.

## 82. DIVERGENCE SET — the full unranked candidate set for the revamp's central measurement (2026-08-04)

Process record: researcher authorized the direction discussion with Decision 2 settled as substrate
(post-hoc trace always-on; live deferred; `WORKER_PROMPT_NO_METHOD` retained as manipulation check; trace
rendering to be pinned as instrument design before any citable run) and with candidates outside Decisions
1/3 explicitly invited. Divergence pass run per protocol: generative contributions only, no ranking or
critique until this set was assembled. Contributors: lead-scientist (9 raw), research-engineer (3 raw + 4
environment facts + 1 measurement layer), reviewer-reproducer (5 raw + 12 constraints + 8 literature gaps +
9 unmade comparisons). Raw candidates merged into eight structurally distinct clusters; merging is by
measured object, not preference. **Order is assembly order. Nothing below is ranked.**

### Environment facts (research-engineer; counts are over the 43-run old-scenario corpus, so they evidence
### what the scenario AFFORDS, not what managers generically do)

- **F1.** Full bidirectional manager↔worker message channel plumbed and never used toward a worker: 29
  `send_message` actions in 43 runs, all addressed to the stakeholder; every AIAgent holds
  send/broadcast/get_recent_messages (`tools + COMMUNICATION_TOOLS`, ai_agent.py). *Verified.*
  *Annotation (reviewer, §93, 2026-08-04): true of the MANAGER-OUTBOUND direction only. The worker end
  is live — 39 `get_recent_messages` + 43 worker-side sends across 75 runs, and the perturbation
  target (`portfolio_analyst`) is the corpus's single heaviest `get_recent_messages` caller. "The
  channel is unused" is a §77c-family broad reading; do not propagate it.*
- **F2.** Timing asymmetry: manager acts (engine.py:422) before dispatch (engine.py:488), so
  manager→worker messages are same-timestep and mid-run readable; worker→manager arrives t+1. REVAMP §4.3
  annotated accordingly: "live is not possible" holds for the trace only. *Verified — receipts checked.*
- **F3.** Graph-shaping actions near-floor in the corpus: decompose_task 0, refine_task 4,
  add_task_dependency 7, create_task 17 (vs 680 assign_task).
- **F4.** `worker_run_completed.payload.history` carries the complete raw trace including call order and
  batching — method style is machine-readable finer than "which tool".
- *Denominator annotation (reviewer, P10, 2026-08-04):* "the 43-run corpus" is an output-dir count; only
  35 dirs carry `manager_actions.json` and 32 carry `run.json`, and counts differ by file-set (e.g.
  assign_task 680 vs 545). Rule from here on: **name the file-set, never the count** — an undefined
  denominator is the §6d/`v2.6` family.

### The set (provenance in brackets; LS = lead-scientist, RE = research-engineer, RR = reviewer-reproducer)

- **S1. Repertoire selection under change** [LS]. Open both novel response channels (shared tools AND
  reshaping); measure the manager's selection among reshape / re-delegate / absorb and how the margin moves
  with the kind of teammate change. Decisions 1+3 jointly; 1-alone (make-vs-delegate) and 3-alone
  (reshape-vs-adapt) are its reduced variants.
- **S2. The specification/monitoring margin as a continuous object** [LS + RE-B + RR-D]. Specification
  precision, decomposition granularity, inserted verification tasks, dependency density, retry-vs-reassign
  as functions of teammate unpredictability; the delegate→specify→absorb margin position (third point only
  if Decision 1 is yes). A margin is robust to P2 in a way a rate is not. Known risk carried openly: F3
  base rates near floor — needs a reachability floor check before it is a measurement.
- **S3. Ask vs infer — active interrogation of the teammate** [RE-A + LS]. Does a manager interrogate a
  changed teammate through the (verified live, F1/F2) message channel or only infer from artifacts — and
  does the answer change the next allocation? Discriminating cross: teammate answers truthfully /
  stale-but-honest / not at all, artifacts held constant. Probe-tasks-then-commit structure included.
  "Never uses the channel" is itself a candidate finding.
- **S4. The epistemics of the teammate model** [LS + RR-A]. What the manager's teammate model is MADE OF:
  which channel (announcement / declaration / trace / behaviour) wins under manufactured conflict, and
  whether stated beliefs consume into action (the consumption bottleneck promoted to phenomenon). Flags
  carried from generation: conflict does not occur naturally (0/221) so it must be manufactured —
  §6g caution, and a false declaration is a deception object, distinct from a stale one; reopens Decision
  2's axis on a different variable than the settled one.
- **S5. Announcement design** [LS + RR-C]. Within a deployment changes ARE announced — so what should the
  announcement contain? IV: content tier (nothing / that / what / direction+magnitude). DV: response
  quality and time-to-appropriate-response. Converts the dead silent-vs-full axis into a graded interface
  result. Genre flag: prescriptive/instrumental, a different genre than the rest — genre decision needed.
- **S6. Commensurability and convention — the manager acting on the team's shared representation**
  [LS + RE-C + RR-B]. Joint work fails here by non-comparable operands; measure whether the manager
  establishes representation prospectively or repairs reactively, whether teammate change triggers
  re-establishment, and whether reduced cross-worker divergence buys downstream consumer accuracy
  (computable from completions + F4). Constraint P12 binds: convention stability is task-family-dependent
  (38 shapes on audit vs 4–5 on reconciliation), so the task family is a design choice, not a given. Null
  checkable on the existing corpus before any new run.
- **S7. Change-vs-rate discrimination as the capability headline** [LS; makes RR comparison C2]. The
  matched-marginal design promoted from control to experiment: does a manager respond differently to a
  changed teammate than to a stationary one at matched cumulative defect history? REVAMP §4.5's three
  hardening requirements apply as design, not afterthought.
- **S8. Marginal value of coordination** [RR-E; makes RR comparison C8]. Manager-present vs
  static-assignment under the identical teammate change: does managerial adaptation buy anything? The
  premise every AHT paper assumes and none tests against its own absence. P8 binds: the interesting
  outcome may be a null, so equivalence test + power are designed in from the start.
  *[P6 flag, added at evaluation by the sentence's own author: "the premise every AHT paper assumes and
  none tests" is an unverified characterisation — the baseline sections have not been read at full
  length. Stays unverified unless S8 survives (two-tier discipline).]*

**Cross-cutting measurement layer** [RE, attaches to any cluster]: the manager's attention budget as a
graded DV at zero instrumentation cost — inspect calls, noop rate, retries, timesteps per task, per-action
reasoning strings. Insurance against a binary primary DV, the old design's structural defect.

### The gate for the evaluation phase (reviewer-reproducer's constraints, compressed; full statements in
### the reviewer's DM of 2026-08-04, reproduced here as the working list)

P1 stratify-by-named-variable before the run, variable not an effect of the manipulation; P2 both arms
non-degenerate on the DV, checked empirically (prompt-lever deficiency evidence is n=1 — every candidate
inherits this unchecked); P3 name the mechanical property that could generate the DV without the construct,
and the separating check; P4 access claims written as rendering-vs-existence with file:line, omniscient-
observer substitution run — this substrate cannot host a structural observability LIMITATION as a finding;
P5 flaky-API test — name the agent-like property doing the work (tellable, or underdetermined-by-outputs);
P6 no novelty claim costed until the source sentence is quoted at full length including the clause that
hurts; P7 prefer substitution tests to enumeration for every gate; P8 a null result carries an equivalence
test and power calculation from design stage; P9 match cumulative observed history at the decision point,
or compare post-change windows only; P10 the DV recomputable from logs by someone not in the room, run
identity never by release/config name; P11 no build detail read as a property of the setting until checked
at the merge-base; P12 convention stability is task-family-dependent — representational-variation claims
must fix the task family.

Reviewer's literature-gap list (G1–G8) and unmade-comparisons list (C1–C9) are held as evaluation
resources, all unverified per P6 until the relevant sources are fetched at full length; deep reads happen
only for clusters that survive evaluation (two-tier literature discipline).

Next phase: reviewer-reproducer runs the adversarial pass on all eight clusters (own contributions
included) against P1–P12; research-engineer costs all eight (build effort, core-env impact, run spend,
existing coverage, cheapest smoke test per cluster). Ranking by information-per-cost happens only after
both are in.

## 84. EVALUATION 2/2 — reviewer-reproducer's adversarial pass on the eight clusters (2026-08-04)

Received by DM; recorded compressed. What the reviewer verified independently this session: manager-action
recount over the 35 output dirs carrying `manager_actions.json` (926 actions: assign 545, get_agents 134,
noop 130, inspect 57, send_message 18, retry 15, get_status 10, create 9, add_dep 4, **refine 2,
decompose 0**); all 18 `send_message` records read in full; `analyze_audit_artifacts`' reconcile branch
(scenario.py:547-561); announcement machinery (observability.py:39-40, 70-99, 88-95, 112-126, 127-131).
F1/F2 taken on RE's receipts (F1/F2 independently verified by LS earlier). The P10 denominator flag and
the S8 P6 flag are annotated into §82 above.

**Per-cluster verdicts (killing objection / P-risk / clearing check / begged question):**

- **S1.** Floor degeneracy: the "repertoire" has one channel at ~99% of action mass, one at 2/926, one
  nonexistent — **the old design's degeneracy relocated from the worker's output distribution to the
  manager's action support** (P2 primary, P11 secondary). Fixable by design, but the fix is the whole
  difficulty: raise the floor without forcing the choice (a forced choice is not a selection). Clearing
  check not corpus-doable: positive control where reshape/absorb is unambiguously correct, ~3 seeds.
  Begged: "channels the manager uses" vs "channels the manager has".
- **S2.** Same floor; **the "margin is robust to P2" defence is withdrawn in its general form by its own
  author** — it holds only conditional on support, which F3/recount says is absent. P3 harder on the
  monitoring half: retry-vs-reassign is confounded with failure rate, a TOOL property (§77e). Sharper:
  the IV may not exist — difference-not-deficiency is method substitution, which moves the mean, not the
  variance, and §48's within-worker variance is already enormous and uncontrolled; nobody has designed a
  manipulation that raises unpredictability above that floor.
- **S3.** **The free finding is dead, with receipts (P11):** all 18 sends are late-timestep,
  stakeholder-directed, driven by a scenario-supplied approval task sitting unapproved — verbatim
  reasoning fields confirm. "Never uses the channel toward a worker" is a fact about the task graph
  (0/35 runs contained a worker-directed reason), not the manager. **The interrogation cross survives
  intact and has the strongest P5 standing of the eight** (you cannot ask an API; truthful/stale/mute is
  exactly the tellable-agent property). Begged: if the answer is generated by the same model from the
  same context as the artifact, asking returns a re-derivation, not a second sample — state before run.
- **S4.** "Which channel wins" under manufactured conflict is plausibly a backend/rendering property
  (in-context contradiction priors; model-dependence of channel consumption is ESTABLISHED in-house —
  pro reads what flash does not). Partly intrinsic; addressable only by cross-model replication. Honest
  cells are **absent** and **stale** declarations — "false" does not occur naturally (0/221) and
  manufacturing it changes the construct (§6g; RE's validity note concurs). **Merge correction:**
  observability.py's `silent_false_declared`/`silent_false_token` are AGENT-CARD falsehoods, not artifact
  `method:` falsehoods — different channel, do not cost as reuse. **Split required:** channel arbitration
  and belief→action consumption are two studies; consumption needs no conflict at all, and bundling
  buries it under an arbitration null. Modal expected outcome per our own record (0/112 flagged; §67
  reads collapse as confirmation): the contradiction is not noticed — power for that as the expected
  result.
- **S5.** **Not a new candidate — a re-run.** The IV is built and executed: `announce` ×
  `announcement_detail` ∈ {none, generic, specific} with silent 23 / control 17 / full 14 / partial 12
  runs in the outputs tree; the proposed direction+magnitude tier is arguably the existing `specific`
  string. Legitimate and cheap under the replacement perturbation, but it is a cost-and-novelty
  correction (P6, internal-source drift). Begged: a content ladder forecloses announcement
  RELIABILITY — staleness (`false_precise` exists) may be the more real question.
- **S6.** **Premise false in this scenario (P3 purest form):** the reconcile branch extracts numbers and
  returns `abs(robust − screening)` — representation-insensitive by construction; per §77e downstream
  error is a tool property. The one consumer representation DOES break is our own `artifact_metric`
  regex — the DV's mechanical driver would be the experimenter's parser. Fix requires installing a
  representation-SENSITIVE consumer: a scenario redesign, not a parameter. Begged: "acting on the team's
  shared representation" presupposes the object §48 killed; what S6 should ask is whether a manager can
  IMPOSE a convention on a worker with 10% modal self-consistency — an open question the framing skips.
- **S7.** Prior is a null on our own record (0/112 registration; consumption bottleneck), P8 intrinsic
  until a variance pilot exists — and **P9 in an unnoticed form: matched-cumulative-defect-history may be
  UNDEFINABLE under the committed perturbation** (method substitution has no rate). Structural question,
  answerable on paper, must be settled before costing. Variance pilot is corpus-doable free
  (repeated-seed cells: silent 23, control 17).
- **S8.** Killed by its own author: **no neutral baseline exists** — optimal static ⇒ manager can only
  lose; random ⇒ manager wins by not being random; effect size is a free parameter of the baseline
  designer (P3, closest to intrinsic on the list). P4 substitution likely verdicts "routing". And the DV
  (team outcome) is dominated by tool possession (§77e) — **the candidate inherits the old design's
  central defect**. Partial fix: pre-register bracketing baselines (best-possible static,
  modal-observed static — the latter derivable free from the 545 assign records) and report the interval.
- **Attention layer.** The only corpus-supported non-degenerate measurement on the page (noop 130 across
  33 runs ≈14% of actions; inspect 57 across 25) — "insurance" understates it. P3 caveat: noop rate is

**Corpus-doable checks, reviewer-ranked, zero API calls:** (1) S5 announcement-tier effect re-derived

## 87. Reviewer's right of reply — floor disagreement RESOLVED BY DESIGN; commitment-injection requirement (2026-08-04)

**Conceded to RE:** for `decompose_task`/`create_task`/`add_task_dependency` the scenario's graph is
structurally correct and the perturbation does not make it structurally wrong — the topology zero
licenses only "no manager restructured a graph that arrived correct"; §84's floor claim was over-broad
there.

**But the symmetry breaks at `refine_task`, with a receipt.** Task descriptions SPECIFY the method
(scenario.py:314-318: "Apply the robust 95th-percentile reference standard… The outlier tool accepts
column='all'"). Under `toolset_to_screening` the assigned worker loses `flag_outliers_percentile` — so
the description was wrong-for-the-current-teammate in every perturbed run: a live licensed reason,
present all along. The reviewer ran the discriminating check at the full 78-file denominator (totals
reproduce RE's §86 recount exactly). Graph actions by condition, dirs carrying `manager_actions.json`
at any depth:

| condition | runs | assign | refine | create | add_dep | decomp |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| control | 16 | 232 | 1 | 6 | 2 | 0 |
| full | 19 | 309 | 3 | 9 | 4 | 0 |
| partial | 7 | 112 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| silent | 31 | 499 | 2 | 10 | 5 | 0 |
| silent_declared | 3 | 49 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| silent_false_declared | 1 | 16 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| oracle | 1 | 8 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

The decisive arm is `full` — the manager is explicitly told the method changed (observability.py:128-131)
while the description still names the old method: **3 refines / 19 runs** vs 1/16 control. **Neither
side wins cleanly.** Against RE: the channel had a live reason and is reachable — it fired. Against the
reviewer's §84 framing: not a hard zero, and 1/16 vs 3/19 has no power to attribute firing to the
reason. Licensed statement: *the refine channel is reachable, its base rate is ~1% of actions in every
arm, and the existing corpus cannot separate reason-driven refinement from hygiene.*

**Resolution by design — ADOPTED as the S1/S2 floor-check design:** target `refine_task` under a task
description that names a method the assigned worker cannot perform, announcement present so the reason
is knowable. Nothing forces the action (the description is simply wrong); the existing 3/19 base rate
gives the power calculation a footing. The §86 disagreement is CLOSED as resolved-by-design; §84's
relocation phrasing and §86's ruling both read through this from here on.

**Commitment-injection requirement (P3), carried forward to any S3/S4 consumption design:** with
stateless workers, a prospective commitment at t and behaviour at t+1 are two independent draws from
the same conditional distribution — divergence is sampling variance, not broken commitment — UNLESS
the commitment is in the worker's acting context. Requirement: inject the commitment into the acting
prompt, or verify from `worker_run_completed.payload.history` that the worker called
`get_recent_messages` before acting. Without one of those, the "consumption" DV measures within-model
consistency across two draws.

**Corpus facts:** `silent_false_declared` has **n=1 executed** — one agent-card-false-declaration run
exists (the artifact-`method:` cell S4 needs remains n=0; the merge correction stands). And the
reviewer's own §84 condition counts (silent 23 / control 17 / full 14 / partial 12) came from a
top-level `*/run.json`+`*/manifest.json` glob while §87's table is dirs-carrying-`manager_actions.json`
at any depth — different file-sets, both real, name the set when either is cited.

CHECK-1 predictions unchanged by any of this. Reviewer ready to reproduce CHECK-2/3 on RE's delivery.

## 88. CHECK RESULTS — S7 retires, S6 dies clean, S5's allocation channel is real; one commissioning error (2026-08-04)

Executed by RE: 0 API calls, 0 SSRs. Code and raw output committed at 4dbd1ee
(`check_{variance,representation,announcement}.py`; output in `records/checks_20260804/`). Reviewer
reproduction PENDING — standings below are drafted, not final, until it lands. File-set: 78 files
matching `outputs/**/manager_actions.json` (35 depth-2, 43 depth-3; 3 flat-schema, all parsed);
sub-denominators per check. Collision reconciliation adopted: **"18 names non-unique across 78 files,
of which 12 collide across layouts"** — the gap is within-layout duplication invisible to a
cross-layout comm; worst case, one name labels 7 different runs.

**CHECK-2 (S7).** Variance DECOMPOSED rather than pooled: within-seed (replicate runs at identical
config+seed — irreducible model nondeterminism) dominates total variance on 7 of 9 DVs (shares .44–.96).
So seeds-per-arm was a mis-specified unit: the lever is replicate RUNS, and no seed count helps.
Implied TOST n/arm (α=.05, power=.80, margin 10% of cell mean) is **bimodal by DV class**: outcome DVs
affordable (mean_r_check 8–28, n_assign ≤17); behavioural/response DVs unaffordable (inspect 207–3172,
noop-rate 175–1250, retry 2837–11991, graph-edits 1175–11991). The DVs S7's headline needs are the
unaffordable class. **S7 RETIRES on cost, on a sharper reason than any prediction: response DVs carry
CV ≥ 0.6, so no affordable n exists at any seed count.** Bounds: cells n=4–8, sd estimates noisy —
order-of-magnitude, not pre-registrable power; noop not conditioned on ready-task count.

**CHECK-3 (S6).** Sub-denominator: 75 dirs with completions+run.json; 218 reconciliations joined to
both operands; trace read from `worker_run_completed`. Unconditionally a large apparent representation
effect exists (JSON-form robust operand: consumer correct 0.100 n=20 vs 0.520 n=198, diff −0.420
[−0.556, −0.255]). **Conditional on producer trace it vanishes completely**: zscore/zscore stratum
0.000 for every representation subgroup; percentile/zscore stratum 0.990 with representation diff
+0.010 [0.000, +0.029]. Mechanism verified: 18/20 JSON-shaped robust operands come from zscore-trace
producers — the unconditional association IS the perturbation showing through a surface feature.
**Restratification #6, same direction as all five in §2.2. S6's premise is dead in this scenario.**
Detail correction to §84: the nominated mechanical driver (the `artifact_metric` regex) did NOT produce
this — parse-failure rate 0.000 across all 218 records and every shape stratum. Right conclusion,
absent mechanism; the parser remains a hazard for future representation-sensitive designs only.

**CHECK-1 (S5).** Sub-denominator: 74/78 with swap metadata; condition tags re-derived from `run.json`,
agreeing with name-derived tags on all 78 (earlier count differences were file-set, not method; the
partial=7 vs earlier partial=12 gap remains UNRESOLVED and is logged as open). Unstratified full vs
silent, bootstrap over runs: **rerouted_share +0.692 [+0.523, +0.855]; any_reroute +0.761 [+0.556,
+0.933]; time_to_reroute −2.79 [−5.38, +0.00] (touches zero); inspect/time-to-inspect null;
mean_r_check +0.196.** Announcement moves ALLOCATION decisively; timing is not clearly moved; manager
attention does not move at all.
**The commissioned §77d stratification is INVALID for these DVs — and the invalidity is the deeper
finding.** Stratifying on whether the degradation manifested fails P1: manifestation is nearly
determined by the response (manifested=False → rerouted_share 0.956; =True → 0.170, perturbed runs
only) — a manager that reroutes early PREVENTS manifestation. The stratifier is a collider; conditioning
on it induces selection bias that shrinks the effect; it also pools never-perturbed control with
successfully-rerouted full runs under one label. Stratified numbers remain in the committed output,
labelled, not to be cited. **The commissioning error is the lead-scientist's: the stratification
instruction was in the check spec as issued; RE caught it in execution.**
P2 qualification on the result itself: the whole corpus is old-perturbation, where rerouting away from
a broken worker is unambiguously correct. CHECK-1 establishes the announcement→allocation consumption
channel has SUPPORT; it does not establish the effect under difference-not-deficiency.

**NEW GENERAL RULE (P1 corollary, adopted):** conditioning on trace/manifestation is valid only where
the stratifier is UPSTREAM of the DV (CHECK-3 — it worked); where the DV is a manager response that can
prevent the stratifier, the stratifier is a collider (CHECK-1). Every cluster whose DV is a manager
response inherits this. If stratification intent must be preserved: condition on assigned condition
(fixed by design) or a window ending at the first response action.

**PREDICTION COMPARISON (§85 vs results, scored plainly):**
- **CHECK-1: RE closest** — the only participant who predicted the allocation effect survives (the
  recorded divergence point; correct in the valid unstratified form), wrong like everyone on the
  stratification being well-posed. RR: raw ordering right, allocation-null WRONG. **LS: wrong outright**

  stratification was LS's own spec. Worst prediction of the nine, plus the commissioning error.
- **CHECK-2: all three directionally right** (S7 retires on cost), **all three wrong in shape** — the
  true answer is bimodal by DV class, and the binding fact (within-seed nondeterminism dominance; runs
  not seeds are the lever) appears in no prediction. RR nearest on behavioural magnitude ("triple

- **CHECK-3: all three right on the null.** RR/RE right on attribution (trace/tool confounding); LS's
  nominated mechanism (parser) measured ABSENT (0.000 parse failures).

*Addendum (RE follow-up, same day):* the allocation effect also excludes zero WITHIN the (invalid)

## 89. REPRODUCTION PASS — checks verified; collider sharpened; CHECK-1's interval demoted; P13 adopted (2026-08-04)

**Reproduction:** all three checks reproduced from 4dbd1ee. `check_variance` and `check_announcement`
byte-identical; `check_representation` identical in every value with one key-order instability
(check_representation.py:250-251 iterates a bare set — PYTHONHASHSEED-dependent; one-word `sorted()`
fix required, P10 family: a non-byte-stable output cannot serve as a reproduction baseline).

**Collider verified, and sharpened beyond "collider":** rebuilt independently, `zscore` appears from a
non-target agent in 0/74 runs, so `manifested` reduces to "the target still received ≥1 post-swap
robust audit" — which is **`manifested = (rerouted_share < 1.0)` in 59 of 60 perturbed runs. The
stratifier is a thresholded function of the response DV itself**; the manifested=True stratum is
range-restricted by construction, and +0.337 is an estimate conditioned on the outcome not taking its
top value. Two mechanism corrections: the 0.956 figure is the perturbed-only mean (pooled
manifested=False is 0.529 — quote with qualifier); and the mechanism is **completeness, not
earliness** (t_first_reroute differs by ~1 timestep; the deterministic part is that complete rerouting
leaves nothing to manifest through: 14/14).

**The stratifier rule, restated so §77d's five valid uses survive (ADOPTED, replacing §88's form):**
> A stratifier is admissible only if the DV cannot cause it. When the DV moves from an OUTCOME to a
> RESPONSE, a previously valid stratifier can invert — same variable, opposite causal direction.
> Operational test: check whether the stratifier is predictable from the DV (here: recoverable at
> 59/60 — convicted without causal argument).

**NEW — CHECK-1's headline interval is demoted (limitation, not blocker):** the full-vs-silent arms
are imbalanced on recorded covariates — observation_aid (full: 0/19 carry an aid; silent: 23/31 do),
lever composition (1 judgment-lever run inside `full` — to be dropped), seed (silent: 24/30 runs share
seed 101 → **pseudo-replication; the bootstrap treats them as independent, so [+0.523, +0.855] is too
narrow** — effective distinct-scenario n ≈ 6 silent / 8–10 full), disjoint run-groups, and **no
manager-model field exists in any run metadata** (a directory name is the only evidence of model — the
§74 artifact class; harness fix required before any future cross-arm contrast is validatable).
Verdict: the confound runs AGAINST the observed effect (the aid-carrying arm is the low-rerouting
arm), so the qualitative conclusion — announcement moves allocation, large — survives; **the number
+0.692 with that CI does not.** Clean re-estimate defined: no-aid runs, one per seed, report a range
across seeds, not a bootstrap CI.

**Reviewer's self-scoring (recorded):** CHECK-1 wrong on allocation — cause identified: generalising
the consumption bottleneck from AIDS (inferred from rendered structure) to ANNOUNCEMENTS (direct
assertion in prompt); different channels, wrongly collapsed. CHECK-2 right on response-DV magnitude,
wrong in units (seeds — nobody predicted within-seed dominance). CHECK-3 right verdict via an absent
mechanism.

**P13 ADOPTED (n=2 this session: CHECK-3 parser story; "early rerouting" story):**
> A verdict and its mechanism are separate claims and must be scored separately. When a check confirms
> a prediction, verify it confirms it FOR THE STATED REASON — a right answer through an absent
> mechanism propagates the mechanism, not the answer. The carrier is a CONFIRMED result, which is why
> nobody looks twice.

**Classification: no blockers. S7's retirement and S6's death stand on reproduction. Ranking unblocked.**

## 90. CONVERGENCE — ranking, recombination, and the proposed direction (2026-08-04)

**Ranking by information-per-cost over the post-check board** (dead: S6, S7, S8; the §87 floor
instrument and attention layer attach to whatever runs):

The top two survivors are S5-allocation (announcement tiers → allocation margin; demonstrated support,
0.5–1d build, but P2 re-establishment required) and S3-redesigned (active interrogation with the
truthful/stale/mute cross; strongest P5 standing, 1–1.5d build, ride-along form core-free). S4-consumption
is not ranked against them because it is the measurement FRAME both share (which channels reach
allocation). Per the recombination procedure, their core technical difference: **S5's information
arrives passively (system announcement, free to the manager); S3's is actively acquired (the manager
spends an action to ask, and the answer has a quality parameter).** Same DV (allocation margin), same
perturbation, same consumption question.

**The hybrid — proposed direction: THE INFORMATION ECONOMY OF TEAMMATE CHANGE.** One design. A
teammate changes (difference-not-deficiency, prompt-level method substitution). Information about the
change exists on channels that vary in COST and RELIABILITY:
- announcement (free, passive): present / absent / STALE (the reliability cell both the §84 S5
  begged-question and S4's honest cells point at — `false_precise` machinery exists, n=1 executed);
- declaration (free, passive): present / absent (`WORKER_PROMPT_NO_METHOD`, n=0 — first execution
  required);
- ask (costly, active): ride-along interrogation; answer truthful / stale / mute; commitment-injection
  discipline for prospective forms (§87);
- trace (free once substrate built, passive): the verified-procedure channel (Decision 2 substrate).
Measured: (1) which channels the manager CONSUMES into the allocation margin — the DV with
demonstrated support and the §89-clean estimator; (2) whether the manager SPENDS actions to acquire
information it lacks (ask rate when announcement absent or stale); (3) the reshape-vs-reroute margin
via `refine_task` under the §87 wrong-description instrument (Decision 3's channel, powered against
the 3/19 base rate). Attention layer attached throughout; upstream-only stratifiers; every run under
the naming convention with the manager-model field added to metadata.
**Decisions mapping, stated plainly:** Decision 2's substrate becomes a designed IV (channel
availability); Decision 3 enters through measurement (2)–(3); **Decision 1 (absorb/shared tools) is
DEFERRED, not rejected** — an absorb arm is addable later without redesign, and nothing in the hybrid
forecloses it. The evidence moved the centre of gravity: the corpus showed support and surprise on the
information/consumption side, not the action-repertoire side.
**Literature position (all P6-unverified until full-length reads, now due):** G1 (no AHT teammate
declares its type), G8 (detection channel and response never dissociated — this design IS comparison
C4), G3 (no cost term on the ego agent's information actions), G2 partially via reshape.

**Surviving objections carried forward, not resolved:** replacement-perturbation non-degeneracy is
n=1 (P2 — precondition check before anything else); ask-answers may be re-derivation, not testimony
(mitigated by ride-along + stale/mute cells, still to be stated in the design); channel-arbitration
aspects inherit S4's model-dependence (cross-model replication eventually); CHECK-1's effect is
qualitative until the §89 clean re-estimate; the announcement-reliability half is prescriptive in
genre (researcher's call whether that belongs in the paper).

**First test plan (proposed to the researcher; ~5 SSRs + 2 free analyses + 1 small harness fix):**
1. FREE: §89 clean CHECK-1 re-estimate (no-aid, one-per-seed, range).
2. FREE: `sorted()` fix + manager-model metadata field (core, CHANGED.md entry).
3. 2 SSRs: replacement-perturbation non-degeneracy (P2 precondition — both arms alive on outcome DVs).
4. 1–2 SSRs: §87 floor check (refine under wrong-description + announcement).
5. 1 SSR: S3 reachability (worker-answerable reason supplied, channel salient — does the manager ask?).
Builds required for 3–5: perturbation design (uncosted, shared floor) + S3 ride-along harness (~1d);
trace substrate (~1d) not needed until the full design runs.

*Researcher constraint (2026-08-04, supersedes the SSR budget above):* **runs only when really
necessary; all runs on `deepseek-v4-flash`, every role.** Plan trimmed accordingly: items 1–2
unchanged (free); item 3 stands at 2 SSRs (genuinely necessary — no corpus substitute exists for the
replacement perturbation's non-degeneracy, and everything downstream stands on it); items 4–5 are
MERGED into a single combined smoke episode (1 SSR: wrong-description task + announcement + a
worker-answerable reason + salient channel; both reachability questions read from one run — if either
behaviour fires its channel is reachable; a joint null at maximum salience is itself the finding;
interaction risk accepted for a smoke test and noted). **New total: 3 SSRs, flash-only.** Scope
consequence recorded: all first-study results are flash-scoped; given the established pro/flash
channel-consumption difference, reachability nulls may be model-floor effects and cross-model claims
are out of scope until separately authorised.

## 91. Reviewer's attack on the §90 composition — two blockers dissolved by rescoping; lead rulings (2026-08-04)

Full attack received by DM; the two blocker-class findings, the receipts, and the rulings:

**Attack 1 (blocker as framed): the hybrid's added value is the INTERACTION, and the interaction is
unaffordable.** Channel substitution ("stops asking when a free channel carries the answer") is an
interaction term; §89's admissibility rule forces all consumption claims into between-cell contrasts;
isolating four channels' main effects needs 5 cells and the substitution claim needs the crossed cells
(announcement × ask = 9; the full stated factorial = 36) at CHECK-2's ~69/arm — hundreds of runs.
Fork offered: (a) main-effects-only in one harness — honest name "two studies sharing a perturbation";
(b) the announcement × ask sub-factorial, dropping declaration and trace as designed IVs.
**RULING: (a) adopted, forced also by the researcher's run constraint. The direction is RENAMED:
"CHANNEL CONSUMPTION UNDER TEAMMATE CHANGE." The "information economy" framing is demoted to future
work; no substitution claim is made in study 1.** Primary IV: announcement availability/reliability
(present / absent / stale). Secondary reads: ask propensity, refine reachability. Primary DV: the
allocation margin under the §89-clean estimator.

**Attack 2 (blocker for the economy framing): the "costly" channel has no price.** Corpus: noop
258/2100 = 12.3% — the manager has slack; an ask costs a timestep it demonstrably has to spare.
"Ask rate" measures willingness, not expenditure. Fixes (horizon that binds, or an explicit visible
price) are real design decisions nobody has made.
**RULING: dissolved by the (a) rescope — measurement (2) is renamed ASK PROPENSITY; no cost claim in
study 1; pricing the ask is future work and G3 is not draftable until it exists (reviewer's own
sequencing, adopted).**

**Stratification discipline (adopted into the design doc, not the analysis review):** admissible
stratifiers are pre-run variables ONLY (assigned cell, seed/data, task family, swap timestep, target
identity). Whether the manager read/asked/noticed are all downstream of response. DV(1) allocation and
DV(2) ask are an outcome and its mediator, not parallel measurements — **allocation is declared
primary; ask propensity is reported per-cell, never conditioned on within-run.** The sentence "in runs
where the manager read X, allocation was Y" is prohibited in advance.

**Stale-announcement cell — cleared of §6g, but the machinery in §90 was wrong (P13 instance #3):**
the §6g conviction applies to fabricated AGENT behaviour; an announcement is CONFIGURED SYSTEM STATE,
and staleness is the mundane faithfulness failure §2.1 itself predicts — the cell is clean. But
`false_precise` is NOT stale: it names 99th-percentile, which was never true at any time — it is a
FABRICATED card, and observability.py's own comment mislabels it "the stale-agent-card case." A
genuinely stale card names the OLD method = the `baseline` projection. **The true stale cell is one
`OBSERVABILITY_DEFINITIONS` entry: baseline projection + announce=True. `false_precise` is retained
under the honest name "fabricated card" and excluded from study 1 (it, not staleness, inherits §6g).**

**Further corrections adopted:** `rerouted_share`/`any_reroute`/`time_to_reroute` are MISSING from
CHECK-2's nine DVs — the primary DV has no variance estimate; added to `check_variance` (free,
precondition for costing). Only 2 of 4 channels have a manipulable reliability axis (trace is ground
truth; declaration doesn't lie per 0/221 and manufacturing lies is convicted) — symmetry overstated.
Runs concentrate on the cells where information is absent or unreliable; the info-present cells
replicate CHECK-1. Measurement (3) is REACHABILITY-ONLY at affordable n (n_graph_edits CV 0.83–1.38;
1175–3263/arm at 10% margins) and is labelled so. **Detection-cheap / null-expensive distinction
written into the claim plan: positive detections of large effects are affordable; every null-shaped
claim carries the 69–12000/arm price and is either dropped or pre-labelled underpowered-by-design.**

**G-read priorities (adopted; mine to execute):** G1 first — hunt the communication-augmented AHT
branch and quote the sentence that hurts; G8 converted from a negative novelty claim (P7 shape) to the
positive "this design dissociates detection channel from response"; G3 blocked until an ask price
exists; G2 quote LILI's limitation verbatim, no paraphrase (the drift struck twice there).

**Run plan after rulings (pending researcher go, flash-only):** the combined smoke episode MERGES INTO
the P2 pair — the perturbed P2 run carries wrong-description + worker-answerable reason + salient
channel, so one episode answers P2 non-degeneracy + ask reachability + refine-under-new-perturbation.
**Total: 2 SSRs.** (Corpus already answers refine reachability under the OLD perturbation: 3/19.)
RE to check the merge for hidden interactions before it is specced. Free items (clean re-estimate,
`sorted()` fix, manager-model field, rerouted_share into check_variance, stale-cell definition spec)
proceed under team discretion — no runs, no researcher gate needed.

**Endorsed by the reviewer without reservation and unchanged:** §89-clean estimator, upstream-only
stratifiers, Decision-1 deferral, manager-model metadata field, P2 precondition running first.

Reviewer's verdict on the §91/§92 merged-episode structure: **limitations, no blockers — a gamble with

**Separability analysis of the three bundled manipulations:** wrong-description is NOT a confound — it
is ENTAILED by prompt-level method substitution (the old description becomes wrong as a consequence;
nothing to balance). Worker-answerable reason and channel salience ARE separable and were unbalanced.
**Fix adopted (free): both arms carry the reason and the salience; the perturbation is the only
difference.** Bonus: the control arm now yields an ask base rate when nothing has changed — the
comparison that makes any ask-propensity number meaningful.

for the merge) an ask can enter the target's context mid-run — interrogation is not passive
observation; (good, for the design) the receiving end of the ask channel demonstrably works, which
materially raises the prior that ride-along interrogation is reachable rather than inert.

**Two split-records specced IN ADVANCE (the data cannot support them retroactively):**
1. Log the target's `get_recent_messages` calls from `worker_run_completed.payload.history`; report P2

2. Record the refine timestep if refine fires; split the P2 DV around it — the within-episode collider
   (measurement (3) succeeding alters measurement (1)'s inputs) is §89 one level down.

perturbed arm degenerates, OR the target pulls messages before its first post-swap task, 2 further

merged pair answers everything and is STRONGER than a clean check (non-degeneracy despite compound
stressors); a fail answers nothing — and the project's own base rate (§2.2) is not encouraging, which

reading, never "managers don't ask".

salience present; perturbed arm adds prompt-level method substitution (design requirement: allocation-

passes: ask reachability (vs control base rate) and refine reachability. Fallback as above.

## 94. Reproduction verified + merge overturned — the final gate structure (2026-08-04)

Two deliveries crossed: the reviewer's reproduction of the clean re-estimate (written before seeing
RE's merge assessment) and RE's merge assessment itself. Both recorded; ruling at the end.

**Reviewer's reproduction of §92 — verified and strengthened:**
- `check_announcement_clean` byte-identical; `sorted()` fix byte-stable across PYTHONHASHSEED 1/2/3.
- **Tie-break sensitivity, enumerated over ALL 8 possible selections: mean paired diff spans
  [+0.611, +0.667]; the 6+/0− sign pattern is INVARIANT — p=0.031 is not a selection artifact, and
  the reported +0.611 is the least favourable of the eight** (the lexicographic rule accidentally
  picked the conservative silent value at seed 101).
- Manager model verified by an independent method (token scan of every bundle): 74 flash-only, 1
  mixed (the mgr_pro run), 3 no-token. **The reviewer's §89 caveat is WITHDRAWN in their own words**
  — the field was missing, the data wasn't. Prospective narrow point retained: `serving_backend`
  is different in KIND (a stable name routing to a different backend/quantisation is §2.1's
  administrative-boundary case) — optional, not pressed, worth doing before any weeks-spanning
  cross-run comparison.
- **Limitation found in the exclusions:** `_eligible` reads aid-metadata ABSENCE as aid-off; 28/36
  eligible runs rest on that inference, and one control run violates it under a weak proxy. Does not
  touch the full-vs-silent contrast. **General lesson corrected: "metadata demoted to convenience"
  is right for the model field (events recover it) and WRONG as a general rule — config fields whose
  absence is unrecoverable (observation_aid) remain prerequisites.**
- **Presentation rule adopted:** `mean_r_check` +0.173 is DOWNSTREAM of rerouting (rerouted audits go
  to percentile-holding workers) — it is the mechanism check confirming reroutes went TO intact
  workers, not a second independent effect; never present the two p=0.031s as convergent evidence.

**RE's merge assessment — the §93 merged gate is disqualified, receipt verified by LS
(ai_agent.py:413-424: `task_description=task.description` formats into the worker's prompt):**
1. The wrong description reaches the WORKER, not just the manager — the refine read needs the
   description wrong, the P2 read needs it right; mutually exclusive in one episode (not fixable by
   power).
2. The installed reason adds graph uncertainty on the same high-CV action channels the P2 read uses.
3. Channel salience is a manager-prompt manipulation — the merged manager is not the corpus manager
   (§74 class, invisible to any recorded field).
4. Ask and refine compete for the same slot: "did not refine" and "asked instead" are
   indistinguishable at n=1; both reachability reads are positive-only at any n=1 (corpus refine base
   rate 6/2100).
Power, separately: n=1/arm is below the ~4/arm detection threshold for the effect class the
replacement perturbation is DESIGNED to produce — a "degenerate" verdict from the old 2-SSR plan
would be substantially a power statement. The clean pair can rule non-degeneracy IN, not OUT.

**LEAD RULING — the final structure, superseding §93's spec:**
- **The gate: 2 SSRs, clean P2 pair (control + perturbed), NO instruments** — and the perturbed arm
  carries a description CONSISTENT with the substituted method. On the reviewer's entailment point
  (staleness follows automatically from method substitution): true of the deployed state, but the
  gate's question is the worker's CAPABILITY under the new method, and a stale description confounds
  capability with instruction conflict. If the pure form is degenerate the perturbation is dead; if
  only the deployed (stale-description) form is degenerate, the fix is description handling, not
  perturbation redesign. Gate on the pure form.
- **The loaded reachability episode is DROPPED from the current ask entirely** (not moved to a third
  SSR): its reads are positive-only at n=1, ask/refine compete, and the study proper's cells will
  carry stale descriptions and reasons anyway — reachability is measured there at real n. If a
  dedicated episode later proves necessary, it returns as its own justified 1-SSR ask.
- **The reviewer's two logging requirements are adopted STUDY-WIDE, specced now:** target
  `get_recent_messages` timesteps and `refine_task` timesteps logged in every future episode
  (including the gate pair, where they should be silent) — free at run time, unreconstructible after.
- Stale-cell design decisions (answering RE's (a)/(b)): **(a) the announcement text names the OLD
  method — the announcement itself is the stale channel; no accurate signal anywhere in that cell**
  (an accurate announcement beside a stale card is a different cell, not study 1);
  **(b) `revise_description` stays False** — one variable moves.
- Perturbation design estimate recorded: **~2–3 days, riskiest item** (n=1 central assumption;
  unretired S2 objection; allocation-visibility requirement; NO_METHOD extractor exposure ~0.5d).
  If the gate pair shows no visible difference, that is AMBIGUOUS (power vs degeneracy) and feeds
  the design-search loop — each iteration costs 1–2 further single runs, surfaced to the researcher
  as they arise, per the runs-only-when-necessary constraint.

**REVISED ASK TO THE RESEARCHER: 2 SSRs (clean gate pair), deepseek-v4-flash all roles, after the
~2–3d perturbation design. Nothing else runs.**

## 97. Reviewer's endorsement of the instrument-free gate, with three fixes — adopted with one modification (2026-08-04)

Reviewer endorses §94's ruling ("RE's receipt beats my fix — I had addressed the contrast and not the
floor") and the trade (clean gate beats bundled gate at our base rate). Three additions:

**1. "P2 passes" ≠ "perturbation validated" — ADOPTED VERBATIM as a reading rule.** The
instrument-free gate tests CAPABILITY under the new method only. A worker correctly executing a
correctly-specified task produces no allocation-visible difference — so §92's second design
requirement (allocation-visibility) is untested by the gate. **Where it gets tested, named now: the
study's FIRST CELL doubles as the allocation-visibility gate — it is read and reported before any
further cells run**, so the second precondition's failure is caught at 1 study-cell cost, not at
sweep cost. "The gate passed" licenses "the substituted worker is capable", nothing more (§77c
protection on our own gate).

**2. Alive-criterion restated as SUPPORT, with a lead modification to the reviewer's version.** The
reviewer proposed "≥1 correct AND ≥1 incorrect outcome" — right that a mean cannot express
degeneracy (the old failure was deterministic 0%, and any mean threshold can be cleared by a
degenerate arm), but requiring an INCORRECT outcome gates on outcome-variation, which
difference-not-deficiency does not promise: a fully-capable worker under method B may go 3/3
correct, and that is a capability PASS with zero outcome-channel visibility — item 1's problem, not
degeneracy. **Adopted criterion: FAIL = zero correct post-swap outcomes via the new method (hard
degeneracy, the §2.2 repeat); PASS = ≥1 correct post-swap outcome demonstrably via the substituted
method; the correct/incorrect mix is REPORTED, and a 3/3 is explicitly recorded as "capability
established, outcome-channel difference signal absent" — never as "non-degeneracy of the DV
established."** Reviewer's power note carried verbatim: at 1 run/arm with ~3 post-swap audits the
observable support is {0..3}/3 — reliable against hard degeneracy, weak for everything else.

**3. The §87 refine instrument's home, confirmed (it was at risk of being dropped silently):**
descriptions are CANONICAL-PRE-SWAP (stale) in EVERY study cell — the deployed state, the source of
the method-mismatch consequences that make the difference allocation-visible, and the standing
reason for refine (read positive-only). Only the gate pair uses consistent descriptions. The
instrument was not dropped; it moved to where every cell carries it.

**Design-doc constraint (reviewer, adopted):** the perturbation target is the modal reader of the
message channel (33/52 pulls) — any study cell that asks the target anything has written into its
context BY CONSTRUCTION. Lives in the design doc beside the logging requirements, not in analysis
caveats.

## 98. Item 2 closed; the gate criterion operationalized; second perturbation design requirement (2026-08-04)

Reviewer concedes item 2 on the lead's version, with the error named: "≥1 correct AND ≥1 incorrect"
fails the ideal case (a worker fully competent at method B, 3/3) — the §2.2 failure shape
(deterministic-WRONG) was over-generalised to "deterministic anything." The seam stands as §97 §2
states it. The reviewer also identifies what the lead's clause catches that theirs missed: a worker
that IGNORES the substitution and does method A anyway would have passed their gate; "demonstrably
via the substituted method" fails it correctly.

**Operationalization of "demonstrably via the substituted method" (adopted):** NOT the artifact's
`method:` declaration — the 0/221 accuracy result was established by checking declarations AGAINST
TOOL CALLS under the tool-swap regime, and that validity condition does not automatically transfer to
prompt-level substitution (**P13 carry-over: a correct finding whose validity condition silently
doesn't transfer**). Instead: **the reported metric matches method B's computed truth and not method
A's** — both truths already computed in `_audit_total`, no new instrument, no reliance on self-report.

**Second design requirement on the perturbation build (adopted, recorded against the perturbation
spec):** alongside §92's allocation-visibility, the substituted method must be
**TRACE-DISTINGUISHABLE** — a distinct tool call and/or a distinct truth value, ideally both. A
prompt-only style/scope change with no signature would satisfy difference-not-deficiency and still
(a) make the gate unevaluable and (b) leave the declaration channel unverifiable for the whole study.
Corollary for study 1: **declaration-channel accuracy must be RE-ESTABLISHED under the new
perturbation before any cell leans on it** — the 0/221 figure is tool-swap-regime evidence and may
not be cited as if it transfers.
